simulator.note: Boots as the M3602 family with chip ID 0x3603 (C3603, chips/m3602.py, run_dump_shd8110_synaps_1695_app_starts.py, run_dump_shd8110_synaps_1695_capture_screen.py): the "M3601A 1.1.3" bootloader prints "APP  init ok" and "---HC164 attach OK--", parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1E9103C, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xA7000200 and maincode(AV) ("0B000A001695") to 0x80000200, and starts both cores.  The application configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, populates userdb(64+64) at 0x73FF80, and renders its 32-bpp ARGB8888 OSD through GeM36F / GMA layer 0.

desc: Amiko SHD-8110 (System ID 0B000A00) firmware Synaps 1.6.95 by Dekolte (2015-10-19) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3601A / M3606 (C3603) Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver.
Uses a dual-CPU "M3606 SEE" architecture with SEE running at 0xA7000200, an ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and a 44-entry 0x44xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
